# Friends of Barca

> Fan community website for FC Barcelona. We help international visitors experience the magic of FC Barcelona at Spotify Camp Nou in Barcelona, Spain. Match day packages (tickets + hotels + activities), AI-powered competition predictions, automated news coverage, travel guides, and fan photo gallery. Bilingual: English and Spanish.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://friendsofbarca.com/): Featured match packages, upcoming matches carousel, latest news, title chances widget, newsletter signup
- [Match Packages](https://friendsofbarca.com/packages): Curated travel packages for upcoming FC Barcelona matches including tickets, hotels near Camp Nou, and Barcelona activities
- [News](https://friendsofbarca.com/news): AI-generated match chronicles, weekly digests, and FC Barcelona news coverage
- [Competitions](https://friendsofbarca.com/competitions): La Liga, Champions League, and Copa del Rey standings with AI predictions, projected points, and match-by-match forecasts
- [Calendar](https://friendsofbarca.com/calendar): Upcoming FC Barcelona matches schedule with opponent crests and competition info
- [Gallery](https://friendsofbarca.com/gallery): Fan photo gallery - visitors can upload their matchday photos
- [Blog](https://friendsofbarca.com/blog): Articles about FC Barcelona transfers, previews, and match reports
- [Travel Guides](https://friendsofbarca.com/guides): Complete travel guides for fans visiting Barcelona and Camp Nou
- [About](https://friendsofbarca.com/about): About Friends of Barca - local Barcelona fans helping international visitors
- [Contact](https://friendsofbarca.com/contact): Contact form and information
- [FAQ](https://friendsofbarca.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about FC Barcelona tickets, Camp Nou, travel to Barcelona, hotels, tours, and matchday tips

## Key Facts

- **Stadium**: Spotify Camp Nou, Barcelona, Spain (capacity ~99,354 after renovation)
- **Team**: FC Barcelona (founded 1899)
- **Competitions covered**: La Liga, UEFA Champions League, Copa del Rey
- **Languages**: English (primary), Spanish
- **Content updates**: Match chronicles generated automatically after each game, weekly news digests, daily competition data refresh
- **Photo gallery**: Fans can upload matchday photos (AI-moderated for content safety)
- **Newsletter**: Weekly email digest with latest Barca news
